g.text: Solid = measured q, k, v, o, gate, up, down per layer. Dashed = roofline (300 GB/s weight reads, datasheet compute peak).

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'system-ui', '-apple-system', 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: Ours includes activation quantization (as the engine runs it); cuBLAS FP8 uses per-tensor scales.
